resources.string: Bring your steps, sleep, and heart-rate summaries into WithYou when you choose.

Only compact summaries are shared with WithYou. Your detailed health history stays in Health Connect. The helper refreshes about every minute while open. Android schedules background work no more often than about every 15 minutes, and may delay it for battery or network conditions.
This should only take a moment.
Not synced yet · refreshes automatically while open

WithYou reads steps, sleep, and heart rate only after you grant access. This helper turns recent records into small summaries on your phone and can refresh them automatically in the foreground or through battery-safe periodic background work. It does not upload individual heart-rate samples or your full health history. WithYou is a wellness project and does not provide a diagnosis or medical advice.
